sentences.text:
Shri R.N. Chaturvedi - Advocate for petitioner.
 Shri A.S. Baghel - Government Advocate for respondents/S

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State prays for and is granted further four weeks' time,
as a matter of last indulgence, to bring on record the notification as well as to clarify with respect to the disbursement of the compensation to the concerned person.

The reply should also clarify the position with respect to Section 11(4) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 regarding prohibition on such transaction after issuance of notification and Rule 5 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement (Compensation, Rehabilitation and Resettlement and Development Plan) Rules, 2015 relating to updation of the land record.
